verdict.rationale: Gumroad's own llms.txt points to API documentation at gumroad.com/api, describing a public REST API for products, sales, subscribers and licenses, plus OAuth and MCP access so an agent can manage products and check payouts. The evidence is a single first-party summary line, though: probes found no OpenAPI spec and no markdown version of the docs. Missing for 10: in-depth endpoint documentation in the evidence, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: [API documentation](https://gumroad.com/api): public REST API for products, sales, subscribers, and licenses
OAuth + MCP so an agent can list sales, draft and edit a product, add the files and links buyers receive and a cover image, publish it, and check payouts for a connected creator
